skills.name: copy-editing
skills.use_when: edit existing marketing copy: tighten, cut filler, sharpen one message, proofread

skills.name: copywriting
skills.use_when: write or rewrite marketing copy: headlines, hooks, value proposition, CTA, landing and feature pages

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.use_when: make a web page or app screen look designed, not templated: dealt art directions, no-slop house rules, screenshot look-and-fix loop

skills.name: diagram-design
skills.use_when: a branded editorial diagram (architecture, flowchart, sequence, timeline, ER, quadrant, chart, ...) as self-contained HTML/SVG, exportable to PNG

skills.name: hallmark
skills.use_when: build a new page or visual identity that looks made, not generated: the Floor, dealt themes, one idea per screen, sloplint; do not run install-hook or imagegen (paid key)

skills.name: house-diagram-style
skills.use_when: make or redo a post/page diagram in the team's house style (palette, type, layout, density, words, what to avoid): paper style by default, rendered from the diagram skill's JSON spec to PNG + HTML; five trial-only styles

skills.name: humanizer
skills.use_when: rewrite AI-sounding prose (scripts, posts, docs, asks) so it reads like a person: cuts staged contrasts, triads, dashes, inflation, stock words

skills.name: hyperframes
skills.use_when: make, edit or render a HyperFrames video (HTML to MP4): render contract, work loop, captions, vertical clips; video/ renders with it

skills.name: hyperframes-cli
skills.use_when: the HyperFrames CLI by job: check, look at frames, render, recover from failures; keep telemetry off, no cloud render or publish

skills.name: hyperframes-registry
skills.use_when: ready-made HyperFrames blocks (captions, kinetic type, transitions, overlays) before hand-building one

skills.name: paper-deck
skills.use_when: make a deck, slide pages, a one-pager, an explainer or a product page for any of the team's products in the team's paper deck style (warm paper, one deep green, Newsreader and Instrument Sans, one idea per screen, looping scenes); starter kit, tokens from the shared paper brand file

skills.name: security-audit
skills.use_when: Security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, services, CLI tools, libraries, and daemons.

skills.name: social
skills.use_when: write social posts and short-video hooks for X, LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram; repurpose one piece across channels

skills.name: video
skills.use_when: plan a marketing or demo video: hook, script, structure, platform specs, AI/programmatic tools (HyperFrames, Remotion)
